The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra earmarks 5% of district planning funds to tackle fodder shortage
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Under the plan, fodder seeds will be supplied through Mahabeej and other agencies for the Rabi season, while cultivation of low-water-requirement crops such as maize, jowar and bajra will be encouraged

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra FDA issues order to curb sale, repackaging of expired food items
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Speaking at a press conference in October 30, Mr. Mundhe says that instead of destroying stale and expired food items properly, they are being “disposed of only on paper.” These goods are brought back after being repacked by some agents and then sold to citizens. In some cases, even the production dates are being manipulated

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: President Murmu inaugurates Simhastha Kumbh preparations in Nashik
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Along with President Droupadi Murmu, the ceremony was attended by Maharashtra Governor Jishnu Dev Varma, Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis and Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit Pawar, among other ministers of the State

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: IIT Bombay student death: Parents seek CBI investigation
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The petition alleged that police had failed to probe the case with the seriousness it merits and, hence, sought the probe to be monitored by a retired judge

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Ajay Devgn moves Bombay High Court against FDA notice over Vimal Elaichi advertisements
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The FDA said on October 30 that its proceedings against three actors had ended and that the matter would go before the Joint Commissioner for adjudication

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Woman rams multiple vehicles, tries to run over cops in Mumbai; booked
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The woman sped away after hitting a stationary car, knocking down a scooter, a motorcycle, and another car during her escape attempt, police official said

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: High Court orders Maharashtra government to pay ₹2 lakh compensation to activist for illegal arrest
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Arun Ferreira was arrested in 2007 in multiple cases. Following acquittal in all the cases, the activist was to be released from Nagpur prison in September 2011
